scope: All paths are relative to the exact initialized PRIVATE companion Git root. These declarations do not run mailbox operations, initialize state or authorize retirement. Explicit output overrides outside these families need their own reviewed entries. Undeclared files remain inventory failures.
budget_policy: A 64 MiB aggregate working-tree review threshold, excluding Git administration. A threshold breach remains a failed capacity check and never authorizes deletion of required state, configuration, selected deliverables or recovery evidence.
